progress_summary: v1.9 compliance scope was assessed without claiming certification. No .opchain/compliance.yaml exists, so the conditional compliance evidence gate is correctly inactive. Apache-2.0 distribution terms, security reporting, data inventory, published retention periods, processor boundaries, and the destructive legacy-checkpoint migration are documented and covered by release gates. No framework mapping or audit-ready certification bundle is asserted.

key_decisions: Absence of .opchain/compliance.yaml means no framework is activated and no evidence bundle is required.
The release records readiness evidence only and must not use certification language.
Legacy checkpoint deletion is disclosed as an irreversible compatibility migration and occurs only after hardened production verification.
